subject: Post-signature MAP: staged execution roadmap, canary window & training cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@bluepine.io>, Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@bluepine.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Post-signature MAP: staged execution roadmap, canary window & training cadence

Hi Sophie / Elena —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get Bluepine onto Redwood. Attached is the initial MAP (BP_MAP_v1.pdf) with the proposal for a staged deployment: a two-week pilot (canary) targeting the research team, followed by a controlled migration of the production traffic in three waves. Highlights: 

- Week 1–2: Canary (5% traffic, read-only heavy workload) with daily health checks and rollback gates.
- Week 3–6: Migration waves (25% -> 60% -> 100%) with automated KV cache warmup and KV-prefix caching enabled.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions (admin + dev) during week 2 and a 60-minute runbook walk-through prior to the first migration wave.

I've also dropped an evaluation plan (EvalPlan_v2.xlsx) in the Drive link below so we can align on metrics (latency P95, token cost delta, inferred-quality checks).

As next steps: please confirm your preferred canary start date window (we've provisionally penciled in the week of Jan 8, 2029) and who on your side will be the on-call for the pilot.

Attachments: BP_MAP_v1.pdf (19KB) | EvalPlan_v2.xlsx (48KB) | SOW_draft.docx (12KB)

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

From: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@bluepine.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@bluepine.io>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staged execution roadmap, canary window & training cadence

Thanks Jonas — received and reviewed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Canary scope: we can start with the research tenant but need to ensure the experiment jobs (long sequences) are excluded from the first 48 hours to avoid confounding the latency metrics.
2) On-call: IT Ops (it-ops@bluepine.io) will be the pager during the pilot window — primary contact: Elena Moreno.
3) Timeline: Jan 8 works for a provisioning start, but can we push the active traffic canary to Jan 12 to allow for the training sessions?

I copied their ops alias. We like the evaluation metric set in the sheet; will add two custom tests (model hallucination rate threshold + anomalous token distribution) and share by EOD Wednesday.

Date: Wed, 06 Dec 2028 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staged execution roadmap, canary window & training cadence

Jonas / Marissa —

Quick ops note after reading Sophie's reply: for the canary we should request a narrower test window to isolate long-sequence jobs as Sophie suggested. Proposed adjustments:

- Day 0 (provisioning): infra validation (disk, GPU mem, kernel selection).
- Day 1–2: lightweight traffic only (prompt length cap 512 tokens). Exclude jobs in queue flagged as "exp_long".
- Daily: automated trace dump at 02:00 UTC to our S3 for offline KV/latency correlation.

I'll prepare a short runbook stub (canary_runbook.md) and link it into the Drive folder. Vivek — can you confirm capacity for the Jan 12 active canary start? If we need a later date we should call it out now; otherwise I'll lock the provision window Jan 8–10.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@bluepine.io>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 07 Dec 2028 10:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staged execution roadmap, canary window & training cadence

Sophie / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. On training: we propose two live sessions (recorded):

1) Admin & Security (60 min) — provisioning, KMS, audit logs, role-based access.
2) Developer & Ops (90 min) — SDKs, streaming troubleshooting, cache warmup, model variant fallback.

Suggested slots (all CET): Jan 10 09:00–10:30 (dev) and Jan 11 14:00–15:00 (admin). If those work we'll send calendar invites and the pre-read (EvalPlan_v2.xlsx + short checklist). I can run a 30-minute runbook dry-run with your on-call a day before the canary.

Attachment: EvalPlan_v2.xlsx referenced in Drive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staged execution roadmap, canary window & training cadence

All —

Great alignment. Summary and agreed next steps: 

1) Provisioning window: Jan 8–10 (infra validation).
2) Training: Jan 10 (Dev) and Jan 11 (Admin) — calendar invites to follow from Marissa.
3) Active canary (5% traffic, prompt length cap 512): Jan 12–Jan 18 with daily gates and rollback criteria in the MAP.
4) Evaluation: we will run the test-suite from EvalPlan_v2 and expect Bluepine to provide the hallucination threshold test by EOD Wed (Dec 7).
5) On-call: Bluepine IT Ops (Elena Moreno) will be primary for the pilot; Redwood on-call will be Vivek Kulkarni.

Jonas will send the finalized MAP and the SOW draft to legal for redlines once Sophie confirms the Jan 12 canary start.

Links: Drive MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC3dMAP) | HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/654321234)

Thanks — looking forward to the kick-off.
